attributes.board_name: Arizona Board of Occupational Therapy Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Workshops, seminars, conferences; self-study or formal course work; video presentations; college course work with grade C or better; publishing (book max 10 h, article max 4 h, chapter max 5 h, film/videotape max 6 h); presenting (max 4 h); clinical OT in-service training (max 4 h; safety, fire evacuation and CPR excluded). CE must relate to the clinical practice of OT; the Board decides.
rules.audit_note: Proof of CE completion is part of the renewal under R4-43-202; licensees may report CE through CE Broker (optional).
rules.notes: Hours must be completed within the 2 years before the license expires; the license renews 2 years from initial licensure or the last renewal date.
